name: New House Setup - Standard Inspection
before:
Please conduct the Standard Inspection. 

Cut and paste the below URL into your phone/tablet browser to access the inspection. Thank you.

https://arha.fillout.com/standard
next:
About this step:
Draft this now so the handyman can be booked as soon as we have access. Schedule within 10 calendar days of closing.

Instructions:
1. Click Dispatch to Breezeway to create the work order from the New House Setup - Standard Inspection template.
2. Choose the date. Leave the person blank until after closing; you will assign them then.
3. Check this property is attached and the instructions are complete.

Done when:
The work order is in Breezeway with a date, and the person is still blank.

Good to know:
Do not assign a person until closing is confirmed, so no vendor shows up to a home we cannot get into.
